function.name: concert_book_ticket
function.description: Book a ticket for a concert at a specific location with various add-ons like backstage pass. Unlike festival_book_ticket, which books a ticket for a festival, this books a ticket for a concert.

artist.description: Name of the artist for the concert.

location.description: City where the concert will take place.

add_ons.description: Add-ons for the concert. Default empty array

function.name: festival_book_ticket
function.description: Book a ticket for a festival at a specific location with various add-ons like camping access. Unlike concert_book_ticket, which books a ticket for a concert, this books a ticket for a festival.

location.description: City where the festival will take place.

add_ons.description: Add-ons for the festival. Default empty array
